usedFor: QuickBooks bills the customer; Zoom hosts the session they paid for. A “New Invoice” in QuickBooks can run “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom, so a billed client is signed up to the webinar.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in QuickBooks, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: An invoice for a paid training or briefing is the natural cue to seat that person, and the action registers them straight into the webinar.

watchOut: “New Invoice” in QuickBooks is polling, so registration follows the next check. It fires on every invoice, including ones unrelated to a webinar, so narrow it before “Register Attendee for Webinar” runs.
